name: nTireDMS
description_en:
nTireDMS is SunSmart’s document-management offering. The reviewed product and workflow articles describe document indexing, permissions, version management and departmental approval, including internal notes, hierarchical review and archiving. These are vendor descriptions of intended workflows; operating limits and actual enforcement were not tested.

The assigned legacy entry currently names OxyEnterpriseDMS, while separate current articles explicitly name nTireDMS. The available evidence does not establish that these names represent the same product or a confirmed rename. Buyers still need an applicable demonstration and agreement covering deployment, connectors, recovery, licensing and commercial terms.
description_zh:
nTireDMS 是 SunSmart 的文档管理产品。已读产品及流程文章描述文档索引、权限、版本管理和部门审批，包括内部备注、分级复核与归档。这些属于厂商对预期工作流的说明，运行上限及实际执行尚未测试。

原分配入口当前命名 OxyEnterpriseDMS，另有当前文章明确命名 nTireDMS。现有证据未确立两者属于同一产品或已确认改名。选型仍需适用的演示及协议，覆盖部署、连接器、恢复、许可与商业条款。

sections.title_zh: 以直接介绍 nTireDMS 的资料为准
sections.en:
SunSmart published direct nTireDMS product and workflow articles dated June 22, 2026. The assigned regional landing page instead says OxyEnterpriseDMS. That naming difference does not establish a rename, retirement or edition equivalence. This profile uses the nTireDMS articles for product claims.

A suitable evaluation owner would be a departmental records manager working with an application administrator. A team needing only an occasional shared folder should first justify the additional record model, approvals and administration. Browser access is described, but hosting region, self-hosting entitlement, server prerequisites and edition availability were not established.
sections.zh:
SunSmart 直接介绍 nTireDMS 产品及流程的文章日期为 2026 年 6 月 22 日；登记的地区落地页则写 OxyEnterpriseDMS。名称不同不确立改名、停用或版本等价。本文产品主张使用 nTireDMS 专门文章。

建议由部门记录负责人联合应用管理员评估。仅偶尔共享文件夹的团队应先明确记录模型、审批及管理的必要性。文章描述浏览器访问，但未确立托管地区、自行部署权益、服务器前提及版本供应范围。

sections.title_en: Index an invoice before designing an approval
sections.title_zh: 设计审批前先定义发票索引
sections.en:
The product article describes CSV-based bulk indexing, configurable document types/tags, metadata fields and stacks grouping related records. It also advertises content search, OCR, classification and extraction. These are vendor descriptions, without published schemas, thresholds or measured accuracy in the reviewed material.

For a proposed pilot, use a fictional invoice with supplier code, invoice number, currency, amount, department and expiry date. Define whether supplier code is text, which amount format is accepted and how duplicate numbers are handled. Keep deliberately malformed and low-quality scan examples outside production. Ask for rejected-row output and correction behavior before assuming a bulk import is complete. An AI suggestion should be checked against the visible document, especially currency and decimal separators. No file, CSV or prompt was submitted.
sections.zh:
产品文章描述 CSV 批量索引、可配置文档类别标签、元数据字段及关联记录堆栈，也宣传内容检索、OCR、分类和提取。这些是厂商描述，已读资料未公布字段契约、阈值或准确率实测。

建议试点使用虚构发票，包含供应商编号、发票号、币种、金额、部门及到期日，明确供应商编号是否文字、金额接受格式和重复编号处理。故意错误及低质量扫描样本应隔离于生产，确认拒绝行输出及纠错行为后再判断批导完成。AI 建议应逐项对照可见原件，特别是币种和小数分隔符。本研究未提交文件、CSV 或提示。

sections.title_en: A routed note is different from a completed payment
sections.title_zh: 呈批记录流转不同于付款完成
sections.en:
Workflow Services describes departmental notes passing through approval hierarchies and becoming read-only in authorized departmental cabinets after approval. Its payment example routes approved notes to Accounts and archives the final records. Signature mechanisms are advertised; the article’s legal-validity and tamper-proof wording is not independent proof.

For the invoice, specify preparer, budget reviewer and Accounts recipient. Deliberately propose rejection, return-for-correction, absence and duplicate-submission cases in an evaluation script. Require the implementation to explain whether editing the underlying invoice invalidates the earlier decision and how a released note is corrected. An Accounts task or approval stamp is not evidence of bank settlement. Signature identity, certificate verification, jurisdictional validity and administrative override remain unverified. No approval, signature or financial transaction occurred.
sections.zh:
Workflow Services 描述部门呈批记录按审批层级流转，批准后在授权部门柜中变为只读；付款示例将已批记录送 Accounts 并归档最终材料。文章宣传签名机制，但法律有效和防篡改措辞不构成独立证明。

对模拟发票应定义编制者、预算复核者及财务接收者，在评估脚本中明确拒绝、退回修改、人员缺席及重复提交，要求实现方说明底层发票修改是否使旧决定失效、已发布呈批记录如何纠正。财务任务或批准章不证明银行结算。签署身份、证书验证、适用地区法律效力及管理员覆盖尚未核实。本研究未审批、签名或付款。

sections.title_en: Ask how rights and history survive changes
sections.title_zh: 核对权限和历史如何应对变更
sections.en:
The product overview advertises view/edit/share/print/download controls, multiple roles, version notes and audit records. It mentions backup/restore without a recovery procedure or retention schedule. Workflow text describes attached comments and approval history.

Use the synthetic invoice to request evidence for a finance member, another department and a removed member. Confirm how competing roles combine and whether search, previews, downloads and linked records use the same effective access. Compare the source file, annotation, revised version and approval record separately. Ask how deletion affects history and when a backup can actually restore them. Do not equate read-only display with immutable storage or version history with disaster recovery. These are proposed checks; no permissions, versions, deletion or restore were operated.
sections.zh:
产品概述宣传查看、编辑、分享、打印、下载控制、多角色、版本备注及审计记录，提及备份恢复但未提供恢复程序或保留期限；流程文章描述附带评论及审批历史。

建议用模拟发票核对财务成员、其他部门及已移除成员，确认冲突角色如何合并，检索、预览、下载及关联记录是否使用相同有效权限，并分别比较源文件、批注、修订版及审批记录。需确认删除如何影响历史、备份何时能恢复它们。只读展示不等于不可变存储，版本历史不等于灾难恢复。这些是建议检查，本研究未改权限、版本、删除或恢复。

sections.title_en: Price and data responsibility remain open
sections.title_zh: 价格及数据责任仍待确认
sections.en:
No product pricing schedule, trial entitlement, full software license or nTireDMS processing agreement was obtained from these pages. Pricing officially_checked remains false, numeric price and open-source status remain unknown. The old third-party snapshot is superseded as product evidence.

A useful request should identify users, departments, documents, storage growth, scan volume, workflow configuration, integration and deployment. Ask which costs recur, what setup/support covers, how renewal and cancellation work, and what export includes at exit. Obtain hosting, model-provider processing, logs, subprocessors, retention, recovery targets and support access in the actual agreement before using personal records. A multilingual OCR or document-viewing claim does not establish any specific interface language. This research used public articles only; no installation, account, enquiry, support ticket or commercial agreement was made.
sections.zh:
这些页面未提供产品价格表、试用权益、完整软件许可或 nTireDMS 处理协议。pricing.officially_checked 保持 false，数值价格及开源状态未知；旧第三方快照不再作为产品正文依据。

有用的询问应列明用户、部门、文档、存储增长、扫描量、流程配置、集成及部署，确认持续费用、实施支持范围、续费取消和退出导出内容。在使用个人记录前，应取得实际协议中的托管、模型处理、日志、分处理方、保留、恢复目标及支持访问条件。多语 OCR 或文档浏览主张不确立具体界面语言。本研究只读公开文章，未安装、创建账户、询价、提支持请求或签约。
